Terms & Conditions

Version 2026-11-14 · Effective 14 November 2026

These terms govern your use of Secret J's job discovery and account features. By creating an account and checking the required acceptance box, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not create an account. You can browse public opportunities without an account.

1. What Secret J provides

Secret J aggregates job listings and offers optional search, saved jobs, alerts, profile management and CV storage. We are not an employer, recruitment agency or party to any employment agreement. Job availability, dates, descriptions, salary, seniority, links and eligibility classifications can be incomplete or inaccurate; always check the employer's official listing before applying. We do not guarantee interviews or employment.

2. Accounts and access

Provide accurate account information, keep your password confidential and notify us if you suspect unauthorized access. Do not share an account or attempt to access other users' private data. We may restrict abusive, fraudulent or unlawful use.

3. CVs and content you upload

You retain ownership of the CV, photos and profile information you upload. You grant Secret J only the permission necessary to store, display to you, parse (where enabled), and process your content to provide the features you request. Do not upload another person's private information without authority. Do not upload unlawful content.

4. Third-party job links

Listings may link to external career websites with separate terms and privacy practices. Secret J does not control those websites and is not responsible for their application processes or decisions.

5. Availability and security

We aim to operate the service reliably, but features and listings may change or become unavailable. Reasonable safeguards are used, but no internet system can promise absolute security or uninterrupted availability. Nothing here excludes liabilities or rights that cannot legally be excluded.

6. Suspension and termination

You may stop using the service and request account or data deletion as described in the Privacy Policy. We may suspend accounts for misuse or security reasons, subject to applicable law.

7. Updates

We may revise these terms. The version displayed at registration is recorded with your acceptance. Material future changes may require renewed acceptance where appropriate.

8. Contact

For questions or privacy requests, contact privacy@jobsnow.tech. This address must be operational before accepting public registrations.

This notice should be reviewed for applicable local requirements before a public launch.
